title: domexception is deprecated
summary: npm directs users of domexception to the platform-native DOMException implementation.

constraints: Preserve exception names, messages, codes where consumed, instanceof checks, serialization, and minimum-runtime support.

steps.title: Use native DOMException
steps.instructions: Replace domexception imports and constructors with the global DOMException implementation, then remove the dependency.

verification.purpose: Run exception behavior and repository tests.
